mapper.sql: i.item_id AS itemId, i.task_id AS taskId, i.store_id AS storeId, i.store_name AS storeName, i.sku_id AS skuId, i.sku_code AS skuCode, i.product_name AS productName, i.unit_id AS unitId, i.unit_name AS unitName, i.barcode, i.old_price_minor AS oldPriceMinor, i.new_price_minor AS newPriceMinor, i.currency, i.source_price_version AS sourcePriceVersion, i.effective_at AS effectiveAt, i.state, i.exception_reason AS exceptionReason, i.version
mapper.select: SELECT item_id AS itemId, effective_at AS effectiveAt, scope_priority AS scopePriority, source_price_version AS sourcePriceVersion, source_price_book_id AS sourcePriceBookId FROM lbl_label_task_item WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND store_id = #{storeId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} AND unit_id = #{unitId} AND state IN ('PENDING','PREVIEW_READY','EXCEPTION') ORDER BY effective_at DESC, scope_priority DESC, source_price_version DESC, source_price_book_id DESC, item_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT task_id FROM lbl_label_task_item WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND store_id = #{storeId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} AND unit_id = #{unitId} AND state IN ('PENDING','PREVIEW_READY','EXCEPTION') ORDER BY task_id
SELECT FROM lbl_label_task_item i WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY i.effective_at, i.sku_code, i.unit_id, i.item_id
SELECT FROM lbl_label_task_item i WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.item_id = #{itemId} LIMIT 1
